title: India, 1970
tagline: A milk grid, a rock memorial and the end of the privy purses.

morningRoutine.detail: All India Radio's Vividh Bharati service, launched on 3 October 1957, carried film music and commercials across India.

technology.name: Tarapur Atomic Power Station
technology.description: India's first nuclear power station, Tarapur, with two boiling-water reactors, was commissioned on 28 October 1969.

technology.name: ISRO takes its name
technology.description: The Indian National Committee for Space Research, set up in 1962 on Vikram Sarabhai's recommendation, was renamed the Indian Space Research Organisation on 15 August 1969.

technology.name: The national milk grid
technology.description: Operation Flood, launched on 13 January 1970 by the National Dairy Development Board, built a national milk grid linking village co-operatives to consumers in over 700 towns and cities.

technology.name: Vivekananda Rock Memorial
technology.description: The memorial at Kanyakumari, opened on 2 September 1970, stands on a rock off the southern tip of India.
